defs.def: something that you say or write which gives an opinion on or explains sb/sth 议论；评论；解释

ex.s: A few days later, I came back with my first jars of zero waste groceries, and my dad commented on how silly it was for me to carry jars everywhere.
ex.t: 几天后，我带着第一批零浪费罐装杂货回来，我爸爸评论说我到处带罐子多傻啊。

ex.s: As you make your lifestyle changes, you may find yourself wanting to speak up for yourself if others comment on what you’re doing, which can turn itself into a whole household debate.
ex.t: 当你改变生活方式时，如果别人对你的做法评头论足，你可能想为自己发声，这可能演变成一场家庭辩论。

ex.s: The hero’s touching story ________ online has drawn thousands of “likes” and hundreds of comments from the public.
ex.t: 这位英雄感人的故事____在网上发布后，获得了数千个"点赞"和数百条公众评论。
研究人员在参与者完成创造性思维测试时考察了不同噪音水平的影响。

ex.s: One self-deprecating comment is a generous and even confident form of humor.
ex.t: 一句自嘲的话是一种慷慨甚至自信的幽默形式。

ex.s: People have been approaching him in the street; he’s had job    34    and all sorts,” Mr Anderson commented.
ex.t: 这个故事再次告诉我们善有善报。

defs.def: criticism that shows the faults of sth 批评；指责

ex.s: I knew I had done a good job and was looking forward to getting a positive comment.
ex.t: 我知道我做得很好，并期待得到积极的评论。

ex.s: When I got the paper back, I found my teacher had written the comment "Not bad!" Not bad?
ex.t: 当我拿回报纸时，我发现我的老师写了一条评论： “不错！“不错吧？

ex.s: General introduction _____ Main plot _____ The most memorable scene _____ Comments _____ ...
ex.t: 一般介绍_____主要情节_____最难忘的场景_____评论_____ ……

ex.s: When I post the picture online, I will make a comment about how bad it is to feed wild crocodiles.
ex.t: 当我在网上发布图片时，我会评论喂养野生鳄鱼有多糟糕。
